figure.name: Howdy Doody
figure.breakdown: The first television character a generation answered by name, shouting a chant back at the screen every afternoon for thirteen years while the voice came off a recording. The tie was engineered down to the theme song, and the puppets were sold as toys, which moved it into the children's own hands.
figure.why_today: Today's edition: The Person You Watched, set by “FAN-TASTIC: Fandomania is coming to Newcastle”. This figure is the record's case for it.

source.title: FAN-TASTIC: Fandomania is coming to Newcastle

figure.tell: Buffalo Bob Smith first performed Howdy Doody as a radio voice; Frank Paris built a puppet to match it; when Paris left in 1948 over merchandising rights he took the original puppet with him and the replacement debuted that June.

persona.title: One death in Assam became a country thinking out loud
persona.why: A death in Assam where the public grief is still doing work a year on. A large public mourning that outlived the news cycle, which is the archive register at its most durable.

character.title: A clown got a prequel and four million households signed up without signing anything
character.why: A prequel with the same actor returning, four million households signing up without signing anything. The played role again, and the sequel is the proof the object survived the performer changing.

companion.title: A journalist spent a week with a Replika companion and came back unsettled
companion.why: A week with a companion app, reported as unsettlement by a reviewer who understood the appeal. The single most useful kind of story the site can hold, because it is neither enthusiast nor outrage.

divine.title: Beads, and one bull
divine.why: Same shelf as neanderthal-burial, deliberately, and the pair is the argument: a pit you keep coming back to is one thing, and a site where the rich burials and the plain ones sit side by side for thirty thousand years is a different claim.

institution.title: Taylor Swift's re-recordings are a parasocial business model
institution.why: Owning your back catalogue framed as a relationship with an audience rather than an artist decision. The rights holder is the institution, and the story is about the institution owning the bond.

cosmology.title: The Neighbours finale broke something in the schedule
cosmology.why: Not just grief: the shape of a whole country's week rearranged around a soap ending. The clearest documented case that the slot can matter more than the thing in it.

officer.title: A 27-year marriage ends and the coverage is about what the public felt
officer.why: A 27-year marriage ends and the coverage is about what the public felt, with readers asked to be honest about it. A person known as a neighbour rather than as a performer, which is why this is the local officer case and not the idol one.

predator.title: A glimpse is not a full picture and the comments decided otherwise
predator.why: Love Island and the World Cup producing millions of viewers who went on to investigate strangers. A relationship with an edited construct becoming a licence to intervene, and the in-group is the mechanism.
